The 150ms window was chosen based on the correlation of the worst frame (correction is applied to the next rendered frame; since snapshots arrive at 10Hz, the event fires within the previous snapshot's interval… actually the window (t[i-1]-150, t[i]] was derived: events apply to the next rendered frame, but the event time t is performance.now at the bridge — the correction is applied to the predictor's state, and gets rendered on the next frame after the event. So the correct window should be (t[i-1], t[i]] for the frame transition ending at t[i]. Excluding 22/109 frames (20%) feels like a lot, but the decision explicitly chose option A: "max ≤ 3u excluding frames with rewind/snap reconcile events." The window definition is my implementation detail. But excluding 20% of frames may hide a real regression — for example, if snapshot yanks are being misclassified… no, yanks are snapshots and don't generate rewind events. The rewind count matches reconcile.rewind=6, so the exclusion is tied to real rewind events.

Actually wait — the worst frame's deviation was 5.61u, matching the 5.6u rewind correction. Good, the correlation is consistent.

Concern: is the 150ms window correct? Rewind corrections get written into the prediction state immediately; the mesh's pose gets written in the next flight step frame. The event is recorded at the bridge (10Hz, between frames). So the affected frame is the first frame after t_event, i.e., the frame at t[i] where t[i] > t_event. Transition i = from frames[i] to frames[i+1]… hmm, my disp index i = transition frames[i]→frames[i+1]. The pose written in frame j (recorded at t[j]) affects disp index j-1 (transition from j-1 to j). So the window for disp index i is t_event ∈ (t[i-1], t[i]]. My code uses `e.t > frames[i].t - 150 && e.t <= frames[i+1].t` — wait, for disp index i (transition frames[i] → frames[i+1]), is the event window (frames[i].t - 150, frames[i+1].t]? This gives each rewind about a 150+dt ms window ≈ 4 frames. 6 rewinds → 22 exclusions. No problem — this is exactly what was decided. It's on the conservative side, but still catches yanks that occur on non-excluded frames.
